info.name: OpenRegister API: integration links, calendar feeds, access links, vocabulary, relations, object state, bulk and bulk jobs
info.description: Route coverage (lane T27) for TimeTrackerLinks, AnalyticsLinks, AnalyticsSeries, MapsOverview, CaseToken, CalendarFeed, AccessLink, Vocabulary, ActivityLinks, FormLinks, Relations, LinkedEntity, Tmlo, Forms, ObjectRelations, ObjectState, Corrections, RegistrySubscription, RegistryUpdates, Bulk and BulkJobs controllers. For each route: the success path, an unknown id, invalid input where the method validates, and the answer to a non-admin user without rights (with a re-read proving nothing changed). The collection seeds its own data: `00 setup` creates a register, an admin-only schema, two objects and a non-admin user (ids kept in collection variables, suffixed with a per-run id), every folder creates whatever else it needs, and `99 teardown` deletes it all. It depends on no other collection.
